## Intent

Postgres→SQLite-Transfer zuerst als idempotenten trockenen Fixture-Lauf mit Integritätsbericht bauen (`server/src/migration/postgres` + scripts self-test). Keine produktive Migration.

## Preconditions

- MIG-011 (#790) SQLite bootstrap catalog on `main`
- MIG-002 (#783) closed (deps clear)
- Host `bootstrapHostPersistence` + integrity gate available
- Synthetic fixtures only — no production Postgres connection

## Happy Path

- [ ] Frozen Postgres-like fixture → empty SQLite: report lists per mapped table row count, canonical checksum, type mapping, FK errors
- [ ] Transfer preserves worlds → projects → project_members FK and owner/GM/player membership relationships
- [ ] Type mappings applied: UUID→TEXT, timestamptz→ISO TEXT, jsonb→TEXT JSON, boolean→INTEGER 0/1
- [ ] Same snapshotId retry after success: no duplicate fachliche IDs; counts stable

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Unmapped fixture table → fail closed (run blocked; no partial import)
- [ ] Abort mid-transfer → target fully rolled back or incomplete run isolated; successful retry has no duplicates
- [ ] Synthetic owner/GM/player + secret fixtures: post-transfer projections match secure contract; known legacy permission defect recorded as deviation (not imported as prod data)

## Regression

- [ ] MIG-011 / MIG-500 self-tests remain in test-gate
- [ ] `architecture-boundary-check` host package rules green

## Assumptions

- Dry-run scope is the approved host bootstrap catalog (worlds / projects / project_members), not the full Postgres dump
- Known legacy defect documented as deviation: `RPC-SEC-LEGACY-MAP-FLAG` / `BASELINE-SEC-LEGACY-MAP` (player `p_player_view=false` pin redaction bypass) — successor must not treat legacy response as parity
- GATE-02/03/05 and production cutover remain NOT approved
